span.p: §4 What is a cluster? — every algorithm answers differently

span.p:
K-Means — centroid
§5 J = Σ‖x−μ‖² · converges to a local min only (both steps only decrease J) · §7 elbow: pick the bend · §8 fails on non-spherical / varying density / outliers · §9 K-Means++ d²-weighted seeding

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Hierarchical — connectivity
§12 O(n³), bottom-up · §13 dendrogram: one run → all K · §14 Ward = the K-Means objective, applied incrementally · §16 greedy + irreversible merges

DBSCAN — density
§17–19 core / border / noise + the algorithm · §21 k-distance plot → ε · §22–23 strengths / limits · no predict() — transductive

§28–30 live demo — 901 real digits
93.8% accuracy + silhouette 0.187 (not a contradiction: a=8.06, b=9.87, gap 1.81 — 'correct but not compact') · PCA to d=10 → silhouette 0.326 · silhouette in high-D is misleading, PCA / UMAP first
